List brands, model categories, fuel/EV options, dealership authorisation, test-drive arrangements, booking/allocation, delivery estimates and manufacturer warranty/service support.
Used Car Dealer: Used car sourcing and condition disclosure

Describe sourcing, ownership/title checks, inspection, mileage verification, accident/flood/service-history disclosure, finance encumbrance checks, transfer assistance and any written dealer warranty.
New Bike Dealer: List motorcycle/scooter/EV categories, brands, authorised status, test rides, booking, charging guidance where relevant, delivery and manufacturer service support.
Used Bike Dealer: Describe sourcing, ownership/finance checks, mechanical/battery inspection, mileage and damage disclosure, test rides, transfer process and warranty exclusions.
Commercial Vehicle Dealer: List new/used categories, load/seating capacities, intended uses, body-building partners, fleet orders, inspection and servicing. Clarify registration, permit/fitness assistance and third-party responsibilities.
Car Service: List scheduled maintenance, fluids, filters, inspections, service intervals and package inclusions/exclusions.
Bike Service: Describe motorcycle/scooter maintenance, brakes, tyres, chain/belt checks, fluids and service schedules.
Car Repair: Describe mechanical/electrical diagnostics, brakes, suspension, transmission and supported repairs; identify outsourced work.
Bike Repair: Describe mechanical/electrical repairs, starting/charging faults, brakes, suspension and model limitations.
Engine Repair: State engine types, diagnosis, overhaul/rebuild scope, machining partners, parts approval, testing and running-in instructions.
AC Repair: For vehicle AC: describe leak/electrical diagnosis, refrigerant compatibility, recovery equipment, compressor/condenser repairs and performance testing. State unsupported systems.
Body Repair: Describe dent/panel repair, painting, corrosion, structural-work limits, colour matching, outsourced calibration and insurer coordination without guaranteeing claim approval.
Tyre Shop: List brands, vehicle types, sizes and new/retread condition. Explain load/speed compatibility, manufacture-date disclosure, fitting, balancing, valves, puncture services and warranty claims.
Wheel Alignment: State vehicle coverage, alignment/balancing equipment, calibration, tyre/suspension checks, before/after reports and recheck policy. Distinguish alignment from repairs requiring separate approval.
Battery Dealer: List vehicle/application types, brands, battery technologies, voltage/capacity and compatibility checks. Describe stock age, warranty registration, full/pro-rata terms, testing and exchange-credit conditions.
Battery Replacement: Describe diagnosis, charging-system checks, compatible replacement, installation, coding/reset where needed and final testing. State mobile-service areas, call-out fees and limitations; EV traction batteries require suitable expertise/equipment.
Car Spare Parts: Car parts range, sourcing and fitment

List supported makes/models/years, part categories and OEM/aftermarket brands. Describe part-number/variant checks, new/used/reconditioned condition, sourcing traceability, safety-critical parts, warranty and wrong-fit returns. Keep individual prices and stock in the catalogue.
Bike Spare Parts: List motorcycle/scooter/EV coverage and mechanical/electrical part ranges. Explain model/variant compatibility, genuine versus compatible parts, condition disclosure, sourcing, fitting support and warranty exclusions.
Car Accessories: Describe interior/exterior, electronics, comfort and protection accessories. State vehicle/electrical compatibility, fitting responsibilities, included installation costs, warranty impact and safety limitations; disclose permanent modifications before approval.
Bike Accessories: List riding gear, luggage, mounts, protection and electrical accessories. Describe sizes/fit, vehicle compatibility, evidence for safety claims, installation, care guidance and hygiene-related return conditions.
Car Wash: Car wash packages and safe methods

Describe exterior/interior packages, vehicle sizes, hand/pressure/steam methods, products, drying, duration and exclusions. Explain pre-existing damage checks, protection of electronics and belongings, water/waste handling and mobile-service requirements.
Bike Wash: State motorcycle/scooter/EV coverage, wash methods, chain care if offered, drying and exclusions. Explain protection of electrical components, bearings and brakes, product compatibility and final safety checks.
Car Detailing: Describe interior cleaning, upholstery/leather care, decontamination, polishing and paint-correction levels. State surface inspection, test spots, customer approval, estimated duration, drying and limitations on stain/scratch removal.
Ceramic Coating: State product/brand, supported surfaces, preparation and paint correction, application process, curing time, aftercare and inspection schedule. Describe written warranty conditions, maintenance costs and exclusions; avoid scratch-proof or permanent-protection guarantees.
Towing Service: List tow-truck types, weight/vehicle limits, recovery equipment, coverage radius and dispatch process. Explain pickup/destination confirmation, pre-existing damage records, loading precautions, per-km/waiting charges and documented handover; do not guarantee arrival times.
Roadside Assistance: Describe jump-start, puncture, minor repair, fuel or lockout assistance where offered, technician coverage, membership/pay-per-use terms and towing referrals. Explain ownership checks and situations requiring emergency services; assistance is not an emergency-response guarantee.
Driving School: Driving courses, instructors and training vehicles

State school/instructor credentials, vehicle classes, manual/automatic options, learner eligibility checks, lesson duration/count, theory/practical curriculum and dual controls. Explain pickup, rescheduling, assessment, licence-test assistance and separate official fees; do not guarantee a licence or test pass.
Travel Agency: List booking/planning services, destinations, customer segments, supplier relationships and itinerary delivery. Clarify visa/insurance assistance and services excluded.
Tour Operator: Describe tour types, group sizes, guides, transport, accommodation, activity providers, safety checks, minimum departures and weather/itinerary changes.
Flight Booking: State airline/route coverage, booking channels, fare classes, baggage disclosure, name checks, ticket confirmation and reissue/refund assistance; distinguish reservations from issued tickets.
Train Booking: Rail booking authority and ticket support
State authorised booking arrangements, routes/classes, passenger-detail checks, confirmation/waitlist communication, service charges and cancellation support. Do not guarantee confirmed seats.
Bus Booking: Bus operators, routes and boarding support
Describe operators, routes, bus/seat types, boarding/drop points, baggage rules, booking confirmation and operator-change/cancellation handling.
Holiday Package: Describe destinations, duration, accommodation category, meals, transfers, activities, group/private options, child/single supplements and optional costs. State substitutions and customer approval rules.
Taxi Service: Describe vehicle classes, passenger/luggage capacity, local/outstation/airport routes, operating hours, permits/insurance checks, fare basis, waiting/toll/parking charges and booking confirmation.
Cab Service: Describe pre-booked/on-demand, rental/corporate and one-way/return options, vehicle standards, driver assignment, fare estimates, substitutions and trip support. Clarify operator versus aggregator role.
Auto Service: For passenger auto-rickshaws: state service zones, operating hours, seating/luggage limits, meter or quoted fare basis, waiting charges, booking, permit/driver checks and accessibility limitations.
Driver Service: Describe licence-class verification, experience, screening with consent, manual/automatic vehicle skills, hourly/daily/outstation assignments, duty/rest limits, replacement arrangements and responsibility for customer-owned vehicles.
Car Rental: Car rental fleet and usage terms
State self-drive/chauffeur options, models/classes, seats, transmission, rental duration, driver eligibility checks, mileage/fuel policy, geographic limits and authorised additional drivers.
Bike Rental: List motorcycle/scooter/EV types, licence/eligibility checks, helmet provision, passenger limits, range/charging, mileage/fuel rules and prohibited uses.
Bus Rental: Bus capacity, drivers and trip planning
Describe bus types, seating/luggage, AC/accessibility, driver availability, duty/rest arrangements, permits, route/stop approval, minimum hire and breakdown replacement.
Tourist Vehicle Rental: List vehicle types, passenger capacity, destinations, interstate coverage, permit checks, itinerary approval, driver allowances, overnight costs and substitution policy.
Tourist Guide: State guide credentials where applicable, destinations, languages, specialist interests, group limits, itinerary/duration, meeting points, accessibility, entry fees and safety arrangements. Clarify transport and activities included or excluded.
Visa Service: Visa assistance scope and official process

List countries and visa categories, eligibility/checklist guidance, form review, appointment assistance and status support. Separate official fees from service charges; explain rejection/refund terms. Decisions and processing times belong to the authority; never guarantee approval or retain login credentials.
Passport Assistance: Describe jurisdictions, new/renewal/correction assistance, current checklist guidance, form review, appointments and tracking. Clarify that official identity checks and issuance are performed by authorities; no guaranteed issuance or expedited access. Do not collect passports, passwords or OTPs in this form.
Travel Insurance: Travel cover, eligibility and claim guidance

State represented insurers, authorised role, single/multi-trip and destination coverage, eligibility, policy wording sources, exclusions, deductibles and medical-disclosure process through secure insurer channels. Describe emergency/claim contacts and cancellation; do not guarantee coverage or claims.
Budget Hotel: Describe AC/non-AC options, private/shared bathrooms, hot water, Wi-Fi, parking and meal availability. Clearly identify paid extras and facilities not provided.
Business Hotel: Describe workspaces, internet, meeting-room capacity/equipment, printing, corporate rates, invoicing, transfers and long-stay arrangements. State charges and booking requirements.
Luxury Hotel: Describe suites, dining, concierge, pool/spa/gym, transfers and service hours. State access limits, age restrictions and separately charged services; substantiate star-rating claims.
Boutique Hotel: Describe design/theme, room differences, local experiences, dining and personalised services. Disclose heritage/building accessibility limitations, quiet hours and third-party activity responsibilities.
Resort: Describe rooms/cottages, grounds, pools, dining, recreation, activity operators, supervision and age/access restrictions. State inclusions, extra charges, seasonal closures, transport and emergency access.
Homestay: State host-on-site availability, private/shared rooms and bathrooms, kitchen/meal arrangements, household rules, guest access, local guidance and support contacts. Explain privacy boundaries and accessibility.
Holiday Home: Describe entire-property versus partial rental, bedrooms/beds, maximum occupancy, kitchen/utilities, cleaning, key handover, caretaker availability and deposits. State party/noise rules, damage review and return of deposits.
Farm Stay: Farm activities, hazards and guest safety

Describe accommodation, meals, farm/animal activities, seasonal availability, supervision, child restrictions and optional participation. Explain machinery, animal, water and terrain hazards, hygiene, allergy information, safe boundaries and emergency transport.
Guest House: Describe private/shared rooms, bathrooms, reception/host availability, meals, parking, visitor rules, short/long stays and local support. State shared facilities and access limitations.
Lodge: State room/bed types, private/shared bathrooms, AC/non-AC, hot water, reception hours, cleaning, luggage storage and minimum stay. Clearly disclose unavailable facilities and extra charges.
Service Apartment: Describe unit sizes, bedrooms, kitchen/appliances, utilities, internet, housekeeping frequency, laundry and maintenance. State minimum stay, utility caps, deposits, inventory checks and key handover.
Hostel: Hostel beds, shared facilities and supervision

State traveller/student/worker accommodation, eligible residents, age rules, dorm/private rooms, occupancy, lockers, bathrooms, meals, warden support and quiet/access hours. Explain safeguarding where minors are accepted and emergency contacts.
PG Accommodation: PG occupancy, meals and monthly terms

State resident eligibility, sharing options, meals/dietary options, house rules, visitor/access hours, cleaning and laundry. Explain rent, utility/meal charges, deposit refund, notice period and move-in/out checks; do not upload resident identity records.
